clauses.quote: IN NO EVENT WILL SUPERHUMAN AND THE SUPERHUMAN ENTITIES' TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY TO YOU UNDER THESE TERMS EXCEED THE AMOUNT THAT YOU HAVE PAID IN FEES TO SUPERHUMAN OR THE SUPERHUMAN ENTITIES DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT(S) GIVING RISE TO SUCH LIABILITY. HOWEVER, IF THAT AMOUNT IS ZERO BECAUSE YOU HAVE A FREE SUBSCRIPTION, SUPERHUMAN AND THE SUPERHUMAN ENTITIES’ TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY WILL NOT EXCEED ONE HUNDRED DOLLARS ($100).
clauses.explanationTr: Şirketin size karşı toplam sorumluluğu, son 12 ayda ödediğiniz ücretle (ücretsiz kullanıcılar için 100 dolarla) sınırlandırılmıştır. Bu durum, büyük bir zarar durumunda tazminat almanızı zorlaştırabilir.

clauses.quote: IN NO EVENT WILL SUPERHUMAN AND THE SUPERHUMAN ENTITIES’ BE LIABLE TO YOU OR OTHERWISE RESPONSIBLE FOR (I) ANY LOST PROFITS, LOST OR DAMAGED USER CONTENT OR OTHER DATA, OR FAILURE TO MEET ANY DUTY, INCLUDING WITHOUT LIMITATION GOOD FAITH AND REASONABLE CARE, AND (II) ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL, EXEMPLARY, OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES OF ANY KIND WHATSOEVER.
clauses.explanationTr: Şirket; kâr kaybı, veri kaybı veya dolaylı zararlar gibi durumlarda hiçbir şekilde sorumlu tutulamayacağını belirtmektedir.
